protocol.time_step_study: L/h = 32 at 64, 128, 256 and 512 steps per period; the 512 run is the L/h = 32 run of the spatial study
protocol.note: Spatial and temporal convergence are judged separately (decision D10). The spatial study runs every mesh at the same small time step; its frequency error is taken with the time error of that step removed, the time error being measured by the separate time-step study (Richardson extrapolation to dt -> 0). Definitions and the reference solution are in README.md.

criteria.definition: |omega(h, dt_s) - e_t(dt_s) - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega is fitted to the free-surface elevation at the left wall (x = 0) with eta(t) = c + exp(-gamma t) (a cos(omega t) + b sin(omega t)) over all outputs; dt_s = T0/512; e_t(dt_s) = omega(32, dt_s) - omega(32, dt -> 0) from the time-step study; omega_ref = Im(s) of the linear viscous standing wave with free-slip walls (linear_sloshing_2d/README.md).
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(L/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D10 (space and time judged separately) with the M1/M5 working criterion: frequency error <= 1% at the finest mesh with observed convergence, read as in linear_sloshing_2d (strictly decreasing, observed order >= 1).

criteria.definition: |omega(32, dt) - omega(32, dt -> 0)| / omega_ref at 64, 128, 256 and 512 steps per period; omega(32, dt -> 0) is the Richardson extrapolation of the two finest steps with the order observed on the three finest.
criteria.source: Decision D10: a separate time-step study at a fixed mesh. The generalized-alpha scheme is second order; the gate requires at least first order so that the time-error removal of the spatial study is justified.

criteria.definition: |gamma - gamma_ref| / gamma_ref, gamma from the same fit and gamma_ref = -Re(s) of the linear viscous standing wave.
criteria.source: Decision D12: sloshing damping error <= 5% at the finest level.

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), A the area of the current liquid mesh (reference points plus mesh displacement) and A(0) that of the initial mesh.
criteria.source: Decision D11: volume criteria gate the maximum deviation over the run; limit 1e-4 as for linear_sloshing_2d.
